description: src/holon_coherence/providers/translation.py splits streaming TCP chunks on newlines without carrying incomplete lines across chunks and maps streaming vs non-streaming finish_reason values inconsistently.
goal: Fix streaming SSE translation across src/holon_coherence/providers/translation.py (staying strictly at or below 442 lines and NEVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) and src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/sse_tap.py (staying strictly at or below its module budget): maintain an incomplete-line carry buffer inside stream_state across translate_openai_sse_chunk_to_gemini calls so JSON SSE lines split across arbitrary TCP chunk boundaries are reassembled rather than dropped, ensure EOF trailing-line flushing in src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/sse_tap.py and tests/test_sse_wire_streaming.py stays consistent with translate_openai_sse_chunk_to_gemini (so test_bridged_sse_flushes_trailing_line_without_newline_on_eof passes), and align streaming vs non-streaming finish_reason mapping for equivalent stop states. Add and update unit tests in tests/providers/test_translation.py and tests/test_sse_wire_streaming.py covering split mid-JSON SSE lines across multiple chunks, EOF flushing, and finish_reason parity between streaming and non-streaming translation. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: TCP chunk fragmentation frequently splits data: JSON lines in transit; carrying partial lines in stream_state, flushing cleanly on EOF in sse_tap, and matching finish_reason prevents silent event loss and response-format drift.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming and non-streaming translation in src/holon_coherence/providers/translation.py and EOF trailing-line flushing in src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/sse_tap.py yield matching `finish_reason` values for equivalent stop states and carry incomplete SSE lines in `stream_state` across chunk boundaries while keeping every module within its line budget without touching `holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json`.

`tests/providers/test_translation.py` and `tests/test_sse_wire_streaming.py` verify mid-JSON chunked SSE reassembly, EOF trailing-line flushing, and `finish_reason` parity with zero docstrings or comments, and `uv run pytest` plus `uv run task lint` pass cleanly.
